title: EEGaze: Multimodal Attention Prediction in Visual Search via EEG-Based Saliency Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.35757v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual search is ubiquitous in daily life, from locating keys in a messy apartment to finding a tool in a cluttered workshop or an application icon on a desktop screen. While visual attention is to a large extent driven by image content, research in psychology indicates that user cognitive states have a significant influence on attention allocation. A promising way to access information about cognitive states is via Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings. Despite this potential, previous works in computational attention modeling have largely disregarded EEG, and related studies in psychology operate with abstract, simplistic stimuli, or even artificially guided search procedures. We bridge this gap with two contributions. First, we present EEGaze 140, the largest publicly available multimodal dataset of free visual search with realistic stimuli. translated_title: EEGaze：基于脑电信号显著性细化的视觉搜索多模态注意力预测
translated_abstract: 视觉搜索在日常生活中无处不在，从在杂乱的公寓里寻找钥匙，到在凌乱的车间里找到工具，或在电脑桌面上查找应用程序图标。虽然视觉注意力在很大程度上由图像内容驱动，但心理学研究表明，用户的认知状态对注意力分配有显著影响。获取认知状态信息的一种有前景的方式是通过脑电图（EEG）记录。尽管具有这一潜力，以往的计算注意力建模工作在很大程度上忽略了EEG信号，而心理学领域的相关研究则使用抽象、简化的刺激物，甚至采用人为引导的搜索程序。我们通过两项贡献来弥合这一差距。首先，我们提出了EEGaze 140，这是目前最大的公开可用的、基于真实刺激物的自由视觉搜索多模态数据集。该数据集包含来自36名参与者的同步EEG与眼动追踪记录……
tldr: 该论文提出了EEGaze 140——目前最大的基于真实刺激物的自由视觉搜索公开多模态数据集（包含36名参与者同步采集的EEG与眼动记录），并通过基于脑电信号的显著性细化方法，将认知状态信息引入视觉搜索中的注意力预测。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces EEGaze 140, the largest publicly available multimodal dataset of free visual search with realistic stimuli (synchronized EEG and eye-tracking recordings from 36 participants), and proposes EEG-based saliency refinement to incorporate cognitive states into attention prediction for visual search.
